fp_classes.name: synthetic_vendor_tenant_pattern
fp_classes.predicate: Hostname matches '<vendor-token>-<common-suffix>.<third_party_cloud_apex>' where common-suffix is in the synthetic-suffix set AND third_party_cloud_apex in {s3.amazonaws.com, amazonaws.com, aliyuncs.com, azurewebsites.net, blob.core.windows.net, cloudapp.azure.com, appspot.com, herokuapp.com, github.io, gitlab.io, netlify.app, vercel.app, pages.dev, amazonaws-china.com}.
fp_classes.rationale: The same synthetic suffix set repeats across 11+ unrelated vendors with no per-bucket verification that the bucket exists under the vendor's account. The shape matches generative seeding rather than vendor-controlled-cloud-endpoint evidence. CP29 §2 admits vendor-tenant-on-third-party-cloud only when the hostname IS the endpoint signature with bucket-attestation; the synthetic-suffix shape fails the gate.

fp_classes.name: cn_tech_giant_cross_attribution
fp_classes.predicate: Hostname apex in the CN-tech-giant set AND manufacturer is NOT one of the CN-tech-giants themselves.
fp_classes.rationale: CN-tech-giant ecosystem hostnames (xiaomi/huawei/meizu/alipay push-SDK, line.me messaging, vmall.com Huawei store, bilibili/douyin/kuaishou video, etc.) appear in vendor SDK manifests as SDK dependencies rather than vendor-controlled infrastructure. Attribution to the SDK-integrating vendor (e.g., Hikvision integrating Xiaomi push SDK) violates CP29 §1 vendor-ownership predicate.

fp_classes.name: third_party_oss_sdk_root
fp_classes.predicate: Hostname apex (or known-suffix-match) in the third-party-OSS / SDK / CDN / CA / standards / personal-blog root set.
fp_classes.rationale: Vendor SDK / Wave I extraction surfaced third-party OSS library / SDK / CDN / cert-authority / standards-body / personal-blog roots cited in binaries or READMEs. Per CP29 §1 these are NOT vendor-controlled hostnames; the binary mention is a dependency-graph signal, not a vendor-infrastructure signal. The classifier's full apex list lives in classifier.py KNOWN_FP_ROOTS — this rule's anchor_root_examples is illustrative, not exhaustive.

fp_classes.name: malformed_concatenated_extraction_artifact
fp_classes.predicate: Single label > 40 chars with < 3 hyphens, OR overall hostname length > 120 chars, OR apex contains corrupted-TLD characters (e.g., 'symcb.com0l').
fp_classes.rationale: Wave I extraction-time pipeline (regex-based hostname harvest) occasionally produced concatenated-host artifacts where multiple distinct hosts merged into a single gibberish label OR where binary-parser output captured a hostname with adjacent corruption bytes ('symcb.com' followed by '0l' from cert object boundary). These rows fail CP29 §1 + §11 #1 (no fabrication — extraction-artifact strings do not represent real vendor-controlled hostnames).

out_of_scope_for_this_sweep.ambiguous_carry_forward: Rows that do NOT match any of the 4 rules but remain AMBIGUOUS ride forward with notes.audit_review_required=true. Per Q2.A: AMBIGUOUS != FP; conflating uncertainty with wrongness violates §11 #1 spirit.
out_of_scope_for_this_sweep.non_cohort_fp_demotions_deferred: Non-cohort manufacturers (e.g., hikvision, cisco_meraki, honeywell, axon, jacobs, getac, harris, avigilon, brinc, genetec, rekor) with FP rows after reclassification are flagged for v1.4.2 / Stage 2 sweep but NOT demoted in MAC-188 per CEO scope freeze.
out_of_scope_for_this_sweep.sierrawireless_slug_dedup: Slug duplication with sierra_wireless (N=126) deferred to Phase 5 (Wave I.12 alias enrichment) per Q3 disposition.
